name: GitHub HTML Preview
description: Preview HTML files from the GitHub page you already have open.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://github.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data: blob:; style-src 'unsafe-inline' data: blob:; img-src data: blob:; font-src data: blob:; media-src data: blob:; child-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
